name: @nightmail/contracts
description: NightMail Compact contracts (NightMailRegistry and TestToken) and their simulator tests

scripts.compile: for c in NightMailRegistry:registry TestToken:token; do compact compile ${npm_package_config_compact:?} src/${c%%:*}.compact managed/${c##*:} || exit 1; done
scripts.compile:sim: for c in NightMailRegistry:registry TestToken:token; do compact compile ${npm_package_config_compact:?} --skip-zk src/${c%%:*}.compact managed/${c##*:}-sim || exit 1; done
